alt.en: A large certificate with an indigo seal stands at the center of a gray floor. A dotted dark gray line joins it to a stack of gray papers on the right, and a dashed indigo line joins it to a closed indigo padlock on the left.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一张带靛蓝色印章的大证书。一条深灰色点线把它与右侧的一叠灰色纸张相连，一条靛蓝色虚线把它与左侧一把锁着的靛蓝色挂锁相连。

caption.en: Illustration: attestation evidence, drawn as a certificate, is compared with reference values, drawn as papers, before a locked resource is released. It does not depict a tested deployment of Trustee, and it does not show that the checks work as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：以证书表示的证明证据，先与以纸张表示的参考值比对，上锁的资源才会放行。图中并非经过测试的 Trustee 部署，也不表示这些检查确如所述那样有效。
